notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken permanent that can be cast using {C}{C}.
description:
Cast Mana Crypt by paying its mana cost.
Tidespout Tyrant triggers, returning a nontoken permanent that can be cast using {C}{C} from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Mana Crypt by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Cast the nontoken permanent returned in step 2 by paying its mana cost.
Tidespout Tyrant triggers, returning Mana Crypt from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
